summaries.final_summary: Max and Lena presented Acme Robotics, which builds autonomous picking robots for mid-sized warehouses. They are raising a EUR 3M seed; EUR 1.8M is committed and a lead investor has been named. Partner One asked about unit economics and pilot conversion.

chapters.title: Product and pilots
bullets: 3 paid pilots, 2 converted to annual contracts
Lena owns hardware; Max owns sales

chapters.title: Round status
bullets: Target first close end of November
